content: BGG Weight is a 1.0-5.0 community-rated complexity scale (no formal rubric, roughly 'how difficult to understand'); each integer step is roughly a doubling of complexity, so a naive linear slider misrepresents perceived difficulty. Icon-only complexity cues can raise cognitive load for non-hobbyists unless paired with plain language. No major product was found with a polished beginner-facing weight visualization; this is an open design space.
